name: ct_pulmonary_embolism_protocol
description: Order a CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA) to evaluate for pulmonary embolism. This is the gold-standard imaging study for PE diagnosis.

contrast.description: CTPA requires IV contrast with bolus tracking

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, elevated D-dimer)

when_to_use: suspected pulmonary embolism with elevated D-dimer
acute dyspnea with pleuritic chest pain and clinical suspicion of PE
unexplained hypoxemia or tachycardia in at-risk patient
Wells score or PERC rule indicating need for PE workup
follow-up of known PE to assess treatment response

examples.query: Post-surgical patient with sudden dyspnea, tachycardia, elevated D-dimer
